tools.label: Node.js
tools.repair: Install or select a supported Node.js version using nvm, fnm, Volta, or nodejs.org.

tools.label: npm
tools.repair: npm normally ships with Node.js; repair the Node.js installation.

tools.label: Rust compiler
tools.why: Compiles native Rust and Wasm binaries.
tools.repair: Install rustup from https://rustup.rs/ and open a new terminal.

tools.label: Cargo
tools.why: Builds/tests Rust crates and installs Rapid Rust.
tools.repair: Install Rust through rustup, then verify Cargo is on PATH.

tools.label: rustup
tools.why: Manages toolchains and Wasm compilation targets.
tools.repair: Install rustup and run: rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown

tools.label: worker-build
tools.repair: For Rapid Rust development run: cargo install worker-build

tools.label: Wrangler
tools.why: Runs local Workers and explicitly dry-runs or deploys them.
tools.repair: Install Wrangler in the project: npm install -D wrangler; use npx wrangler --version.
